scope: Proposition 2.1 of the manuscript “A counterexample to Sidorenko's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Sidorenkos-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 161 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0c0d7b5eb1ed43c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The complex has the following properties. 1. Every pair in E lies in exactly two faces, |E| = 33, and the face-neighbor graph is connected. 2. For each bit position, each of its two classes consists of 11 faces covering all 13 points. Each class has an ordering in which every face after the first shares a pair with an earlier face and introduces exactly one new point. 3. Every ae is at least 1/3, and some ae is greater than 1/3. 4. Color refinement of H, starting with a separate color for each part, eventually gives distinct colors to all vertices within either part.
